title: Max Planck-Weizmann Postdoctoral Programme
institution: Max Planck Society and Weizmann Institute of Science
about: Seventh round of the German-Israeli Max Planck-Weizmann Postdoctoral Programme: a four-year appointment split between the Max Planck Society in Germany and the Weizmann Institute in Israel, for positions starting March-September 2027. Deadline December 21, 2026.
card_alt: Card for the Max Planck-Weizmann Postdoctoral Programme, offered by the Max Planck Society and Weizmann Institute of Science (an appointment split between Germany and Israel), with an application deadline of 21 Dec 2026. The photo is a generic default image: an aerial sunset view of a riverside city skyline (Ho Chi Minh City with the Landmark 81 tower), not the programme location.
